summary: Sandbach United got their 2026/27 league campaign off to a winning start with a 3-1 victory over Wednesfield CFC, with Bevan scoring twice in an impressive performance from a side containing five new players. The Ramblers dominated possession throughout and showed great early cohesion, though they had to work hard after Wednesfield equalized with a fortunate deflection just before half-time. With plenty of new sponsorship deals in place and a winning mentality already on display, there's plenty to be positive about as the season gets underway!
